# Exa Search

Curated by Skill Harbor: a skill for neural search through the Exa MCP server, covering web content, code examples, company intelligence, people lookup, and AI-powered deep research. It documents the search modes (web, code, company, people), category filters, and livecrawl behavior so your agent queries Exa's engine precisely instead of guessing parameters. Trigger phrases include "search for", "look up", "find", and "what's the latest on". By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: requires an Exa API key (paid service) and a working MCP setup; the skill itself flags drift risk, Exa's tool names, parameters, and account limits can change, so confirm the exposed tool surface and current Exa docs before relying on a specific search mode. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
